usedFor: monday.com holds your project items, and FastBill drafts an invoice when “Item Column Value Changes” runs “Create Invoice”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Create Invoice” in FastBill
bestTemplate.why: When a column on a board item changes, the invoice is created from that item.

watchOut: “Item Column Value Changes” fires on any column update, so one item can create several invoices.
